dict.string: Run named triggers and actions in BetterTouchTool
Search and run your named triggers

on run argv set theQuery to item 1 of argv set theSecret to (system attribute "BTT_SHARED_SECRET")
tell application "BetterTouchTool" try trigger_named_async_without_response theQuery shared_secret theSecret on error display notification "Could not execute named trigger." with title "Error" end try end tell return theQuery end run

on run argv set theQuery to item 1 of argv set theSecret to (system attribute "BTT_SHARED_SECRET") set theAction to "{\"BTTPredefinedActionType\": " & theQuery & "}" tell application "BetterTouchTool" try trigger_action theAction shared_secret theSecret on error display notification "Could not execute named trigger." with title "Error" end try end tell return theAction end run

Select a predefined action to run in BTT

This workflow uses the scripting interface of BetterTouchTool to allow searching and running named triggers or actions within BTT.
To get the list of named triggers, it uses the get_triggers function, which is available starting at version 4.034 of BTT.
Make sure to allow external scripting in the BTT settings under "Scripting BTT" and configure the workflow with your shared secret if you have it set.
If you have set a shared secret, enter it here to allow running triggers via scripting url.
